threads.body: The linked rollout issue explicitly excludes smoke-test modules, and this module has only `src/test` Java sources. Because the new convention disables NullAway for every test compilation, applying it here analyzes no code while adding Error Prone/NullAway setup overhead. Remove this application; the production `bootstrap` and `custom` modules remain covered.

replies.body: Good catch. Removed the convention from the test-only smoke-test module in 67f24e4f17; the PR now applies NullAway only to the production `bootstrap` and `custom` modules.
